title: Smart112Recommendation
description: Contract schema for unit recommendation and spatial optimization for incident dispatch.

recommendation_id.description: Unique identifier for this recommendation batch.

incident_id.description: Foreign UUID referencing the parent incident.

candidate_units.description: Ranked list of emergency response units identified by spatial proximity and capability match.

id.description: Unique identifier of the response unit (e.g. ALS-AMB-04, ENG-12, POL-99).

callsign.description: Tactical callsign used over radio and dispatch networks.

type.description: Operational classification and specialization of the unit.

distance_km.description: Geodesic or routing distance to incident coordinates in kilometers (calculated via local PostGIS).

eta_min.description: Estimated time of arrival in minutes based on real-time speed and road topology.

station_id.description: Base station, firehouse, or precinct identifier.

capability_tags.description: Specialized certifications or equipment (e.g. defibrillator, thermal_imaging, jaws_of_life).

rationale.description: Structured operational justification explaining unit selection, routing priority, and capability pairing.

recommended_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of recommendation calculation.
